description: RANS (SA-neg) verification of the ignisyeet CFD mode; model-vs-model and model-vs-correlation comparisons (verification), no measured data
machine: i7-12700 (20 threads, 30 GB), shared with other jobs
commits: each data file header names its commit

V1_flat_plate_M0.2.quantity: cf at x = 0.97, finest grid (273x193) vs NASA TMR SA (CFL3D/FUN3D 545x385, 2.7055e-3)
V1_flat_plate_M0.2.note: cf rises for x > 1.5 because of the farfield outflow at the plate end; plate CD not compared
V1_flat_plate_M0.2.provenance: rans_flatplate.csv, rans_flatplate_cf.csv (doc/scripts/rans_flatplate.py; SU2 settings of the CFD mode, header names the commit)

V2_flat_plate_M2_adiabatic.quantity: cf at x = 0.97, finest grid (273x193) vs van Driest II (Hopkins-Inouye, r = 0.89)
V2_flat_plate_M2_adiabatic.note: 137x97 stopped at the 20000-iteration cap 5.8 orders below the startup peak (the others 8 orders)

acceptance_rule_replay_flat_plate.quantity: plate CD at the iteration an acceptance rule would stop vs the run to 8 orders
acceptance_rule_replay_flat_plate.note: old rule = 3/2 orders + flat window; trend rule = 73d22f8 (rans_replay.py); the shipped rule adds the worst-of-20-rows drop

V4_cone_M2_Cp.quantity: cone surface Cp over x/L_cone 0.2-0.9 vs Taylor-Maccoll (0.10447), 10 deg cone, wall_size 2 mm, converged
V4_cone_M2_Cp.verdict: mean within 2 %; only the bin nearest the tip exceeds it
V4_cone_M2_Cp.explanation: viscous Cp above the inviscid Taylor-Maccoll value is expected: the turbulent displacement thickness adds about 0.1 deg of effective cone angle (roughly +2 % in Cp), largest relative to the radius near the tip

V3_friction_vs_flat_plate.quantity: friction part of the wall axial force (surface integration) vs van Driest II over the wetted area, alpha 0, converged cases
V3_friction_vs_flat_plate.note: cone estimate with the Taylor-Maccoll edge state and the turbulent Mangler rule (plain freestream law: +11.3 %)

before_mesh_fix.state: prism layer 0.4 wall_size, Venkatakrishnan-Wang limiter frozen at iteration 400 (8f745ae / 3acdb89)

V5_herrin_dutton_base_flow.reason: validation needs the measured approach boundary layer of the M 2.46 cylinder (wind-tunnel afterbody, no nose); the CFD mode meshes a body with a nose from an STL and has no axisymmetric or wedge domain

V6_sample_mesh_convergence.reason: waiting for the RANS startup retry (8 mm M 2 startup diverged on 5ce5795)

V7_rans_vs_euler.reason: waiting for the RANS startup retry (8 mm M 2 startup diverged on 5ce5795)

V8_rans_table.reason: waiting for the RANS startup retry (8 mm M 2 startup diverged on 5ce5795)
